title: Come In & Come to Work
situation: Arriving at the airport and starting the morning shift.
objective: Use come in and come to work to talk about arriving and entering the workplace.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I come to the airport every morning.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya datang ke bandara setiap pagi.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I come in through the staff entrance and check in at the office.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya masuk lewat pintu masuk staf dan melapor di kantor.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My team usually comes to work early, so we can talk before the shift starts.
dialogue.indonesian: Tim saya biasanya datang bekerja lebih awal, jadi kami bisa berbicara sebelum shift dimulai.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When my supervisor says, 'Please come in,' I go into the meeting room.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika supervisor saya berkata, 'Silakan masuk,' saya masuk ke ruang rapat.

learningNotes: come in berarti masuk ke dalam ruangan atau tempat.
come to work memakai to karena work adalah tujuan.
comes memakai -s karena subjeknya my team, yang dianggap satu tim.
